board.name: Iowa Board of Physician Associates (Department of Inspections, Appeals, and Licensing)

licence.title: Physician Associate (PA) license (Iowa rules renamed 'physician assistant' to 'physician associate'; Iowa Code ch. 148C text still says physician assistant)
licence.renewalDeadline: September 30 at the end of the licensee's biennium (biennium runs October 1 to September 30 two years later); 30-day grace period with late fee. A licence issued within six months of the renewal date is not renewed until the following renewal date two years later (481 IAC 780.8(2)).

ce.categoryRules: Minimum 50 hours Category I (AAPA, AMA, AOA, AAFP or ACCME-accredited); remaining 50 hours Category I or II as accepted by NCCPA. Excess hours carry over up to 50 percent of the requirement, maximum 50 hours. One hour = at least 50 minutes. First renewal after initial licensure: no CE required.

topicMandates.topic: CDC guideline for prescribing opioids for chronic pain
topicMandates.appliesTo: PAs who prescribed opioids to a patient during the renewal cycle (counts toward the 100 hours)

topicMandates.topic: Mandatory reporter training: child abuse and/or dependent adult abuse identification and reporting (Iowa HHS curriculum)
topicMandates.appliesTo: PAs who examine, attend, counsel or treat children (child abuse) or adults (dependent adult abuse) in Iowa; attested on renewal

ce.controlledSubstanceCe: 2 hours on CDC opioid prescribing guideline per biennium if the PA prescribed opioids during the cycle

practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: No written agreement filed for most PAs: collaboration is determined at the practice level. Physician supervision is required only for a PA in an independent practice arrangement (PA-owned professional corporation or PLLC) who has fewer than 2 years of prior supervised or collaborative practice; that PA notifies the board of each supervising physician on jointly approved board forms before beginning practice and reports any change.
practice.notes: Iowa Code 148C.1 and 148C.3(2); 481 IAC 780.5 and 780.7. Board may audit CE and mandatory reporter compliance.

prescribing.ceForPrescribers: 2 hours CDC opioid guideline per biennium if opioids prescribed; PMP check required before prescribing an opioid (481 IAC 781.4(3)); DEA registration required to prescribe or dispense controlled substances; Schedule II depressants allowed.

board.name: Iowa Board of Nursing (Department of Inspections, Appeals, and Licensing)

rn.renewalDeadline: 15th day of the licensee's birth month in the renewal year; renewal opens 60 days before expiration; late renewal with late fee until the 15th day of the month after expiration, after which the licence is inactive (481 IAC 617.8(3)-(5)).
rn.ceNotes: Current national certification or recertification counts as 36 contact hours. Up to 18 excess hours may carry over.

topicMandates.topic: Mandatory reporter training: child abuse and/or dependent adult abuse identification and reporting (Iowa HHS curriculum)
topicMandates.appliesTo: Nurses who regularly examine, attend, counsel or treat children (child abuse training) or adults (dependent adult abuse training) in Iowa; training within the previous three years, attested on renewal; documentation kept three years

aprn.title: ARNP (Advanced Registered Nurse Practitioner); NP role is 'certified nurse practitioner' with a population focus
aprn.separateLicenceOrCertificate: separate ARNP license (one application per population focus)
aprn.renewalNotes: ARNP license expires on the same date as the RN license; renew from 60 days before to 30 days after expiration
aprn.ceNotes: No separate ARNP contact hour count found in 481 IAC 621; the 36 RN contact hours apply (621.6(3) counts opioid hours toward 'the 36 contact hours required for license renewal').

topicMandates.topic: CDC guideline for prescribing opioids for chronic pain
topicMandates.appliesTo: ARNPs who prescribed opioids to a patient during the renewal cycle (counts toward 36 hours)

prescribing.controlledSubstanceCe: 2 contact hours CDC opioid guideline every 3-year renewal if opioids prescribed

practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: None. Collaboration in Iowa ARNP rules means joint management with a physician 'as needed'; no agreement is filed.

unverified: Iowa Code 148C (2026 Code PDF, printed December 2025) still says 'physician assistant'; 481 IAC 780 to 782 (IAC 9/30/26) say 'physician associate' and 'board of physician associates'. The session law behind the title change was not loaded.
Iowa ARNP rules (481 IAC 621) state no separate pharmacology hour requirement and no transition-to-practice hours; this is an absence in the rule, not an affirmative statement.
Mandatory reporter training has no hour count in the PA or nursing rules (curriculum set by Iowa HHS); hours left null.
The ARNP CE total (36 contact hours) is inferred from 621.6(3), which counts opioid hours toward 'the 36 contact hours required for license renewal'; 481 IAC 621 has no separate ARNP hour rule.
verificationNotes: All IA facts re-loaded 2026-10-01 from legis.iowa.gov (IAC supplement dated 9/30/26; Iowa Code 2026). Every value and quote matched.
corrections: IA PA renewalDeadline: added 481 IAC 780.8(2) (licence issued within six months of the renewal date first renews two years later).

IA PA stateCsRegistrationRequired: researcher's open question resolved. Loaded Iowa Code 124.101(9); 'dispense' expressly includes prescribing, so 124.302 registration applies to prescribing PAs. Fact added; item removed from unverified.
IA PA practice: added 481 IAC 780.7(5) (collaborating non-physician provider must have 5 years in practice and no discipline during the two-year period).
IA RN renewalDeadline: added the late window (to the 15th of the following month, then inactive) from 481 IAC 617.8(4)-(5); researcher listed only the opening date.
IA RN mandatory reporter appliesTo: rule says 'regularly examines, attends, counsels or treats'; wording tightened.
